    AD Plus 2.0 Accessories

    Channel + CAN-bus expansion modules for AD Plus 2.0 deployments.

    PBM (Power Box Max)
    Enables AD Plus 2.0 to add 2 extra channels AND read CAN bus / OBD-II / J1939. Pick this if you need channel count or CAN.

    PBP (Power Box Plus)
    Enables AD Plus 2.0 to read CAN bus / OBD-II without the extra channels. Pick this if you only need vehicle-data integration.

    The "one-device" architecture — why one Streamax camera replaces your tracker

    Traditionally video telematics + GPS tracking required two devices — a separate tracker plus a separate camera, with two installations, two cellular plans, and two points of failure.

    Streamax cameras read native vehicle data via CAN bus / OBD-II / J1939 / FMS. One camera does everything:

    CapabilityTraditional (2 devices)Streamax (1 camera)
    Video AI (ADAS + DMS)CameraBuilt in
    GPS tracking & trip recordingTrackerBuilt in
    Vehicle ECU data (speed, RPM, fuel, fault codes)Tracker via J1939Built in — native CAN
    Sensor gateway (TPMS, fuel, temp, door, RFID)Separate hubBuilt in
    Cellular plans2–31
    Installation2 mounts, 2 wiring jobs1 cable, ~15 min
